name: Xiangli Yao

tierList.prydwen: T3 Tower of Adversity, T4 Whimpering Wastes - noted as very accessible/forgiving DPS

kit.intro: 5-star Electro Gauntlets DPS with an unusually long (24s) and forgiving Ultimate burst window that grants interruption resistance, reducing reliance on swap-cancels. In Ultimate ('Intuition'), gains 3 'Hypercube' charges spent on enhanced Skill 'Law of Reigns' (costs 5 Performance Capacity each), the core of his damage.

skills.normalAttack: Probe - up to 5-hit chain; enhanced 'Pivot - Impale' 3-hit combo during Intuition.
skills.resonanceSkill: Deduction - Electro DMG, short 5s cooldown, generates Concerto/Resonance Energy; becomes 'Decipher' at full standard Capacity, 'Divergence'/'Law of Reigns' during Intuition.
skills.forte: Forever Seeking - Capacity/Performance Capacity gauges governing Decipher and the Intuition-state Law of Reigns loop.
skills.liberation: Cogitation Model - Electro DMG nuke, enters 24s 'Intuition' state (enhanced kit, 3 Hypercubes).
skills.outro: Chain Rule - next character's first Basic Attack hit triggers a laser AoE (237.6% ATK) for 8s, up to 3 times.

bestWeapons: Legend of Drunken Hero (best F2P no-gacha)
echoSet: Void Thunder (5pc, best, ramping Electro DMG)

teams.name: Best Team
teams.notes: Lynae edges out Yinlin due to a more well-rounded buffing profile alongside a similar Outro effect.

teams.name: Expert Team (Dual DPS)
teams.notes: Extremely quickswap-reliant, one of the highest-damage pairs in the game if mastered, not recommended for casual play.

teams.name: Budget Team
teams.notes: Yangyang is the best non-limited-5-star option; Jianxin viable but has field-time/Energy issues.

rotation: Intro -> Skill (cancelled by Ultimate) -> Ultimate -> Skill (Divergence) -> Mid-air (Revamp) -> Skill (Law of Reigns) -> Basic Pivot-Impale P1-P3 -> Skill (Law of Reigns) -> Skill (Divergence) -> Mid-air (Revamp) -> Skill (Law of Reigns) -> Outro. 24s Ultimate duration leaves ample room for dodges, swaps, and mistakes.
communityNotes: Prydwen: notably accessible and forgiving 5-star DPS thanks to his long, interruption-resistant Ultimate window (unlike swap-cancel-dependent characters like Calcharo); was free to obtain around his release patch. Strong with Lynae/Yinlin as buffers; his Dual-DPS synergy with Changli is very powerful but extremely execution-heavy.
